title: Bring any website in with the help of AI
text: Point Greemo at your current site and let AI help move it across: pages, copy, images and structure become markdown content, collections and templates in your Greemo workspace. Then you review and edit everything visually.
ticks: Repeating content becomes JSON collections, such as services or posts
Layout becomes theme sections via template annotations
Review and apply or reject each AI change, then refine it in the visual editor
source: Grounded in: docs/AI_TOOLS.md (create-site, add-page, update-collection; review and apply in the assistant). The URL import flow shown is a concept.

title: Get your website in
text: Already have the code or the content? Bring it in without AI. Greemo imports a Vue + Vite project back into a site with round-trip support, and your pages are plain markdown with comment-tag templates.
ticks: `greemo import --input … --output …` turns a Vue + Vite project into a Greemo site
Export, import and export again: the files should be identical
Markdown pages with `<!-- template name="hero" -->` tags

title: Don’t worry about performance any more
text: Greemo sites are built ahead of time. Markdown and theme sections become a Vue/Vite site, compiled into static pages you can host anywhere, styled with Tailwind 4.
ticks: Vite production builds, with Tailwind 4 styling
Deploy over SSH, to S3 or to GitHub Pages
source: Source: README.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (Data Flow, Build Process), docs/GETTING_STARTED.md (Deployment)

title: Connect it to any data source
text: Content does not have to live in one place. Collections read from local JSON or a REST endpoint, pages pull data in with data tags, and static JSON, YAML and CSV files are supported. SQLite and database sources are listed as coming soon in the editor.
ticks: Collections from Local JSON or REST
Data tags such as `<!-- data source="posts" format="json" -->`
source: Source: docs/GETTING_STARTED.md (Data Sources), docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (Data Tags), apps/web/src/components/DatasetTabEditor.vue, packages/core/src/types.ts

title: Work locally
text: Greemo runs on your own machine. Start it with `npm run dev`, choose the folder where your sites live, and every site is plain files you can keep in a git repo.
ticks: Local-first: reads and writes `sites/<slug>/…` on disk
See the commits that changed a page from the editor
